notes.title: Major HVOR Update
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044918/d38eea75d99768406488ce4057497d5696149827.jpg"][/img][/h1][p]Hello survivors!
We’re excited to present a major update we’ve been working on over the past few months.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Technology[/h2][list][*][p]Migration from [b]UE4 to Unreal Engine 5[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Support for [b]dynamic lighting[/b] and [b]ray tracing[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reworked networking, stable [b]online and cross-platform play[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added support for [b]Linux and macOS[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We know the game is now more demanding on graphics cards, but it’s been almost 5 years since the last update — most players now have much more powerful hardware, so this shouldn’t be an issue.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Interface[/h2][p]The UI has been refreshed and modernized.
Gameplay itself hasn’t changed yet — this step was all about building a foundation for the future. The main goal was to move away from outdated technologies so we can continue to grow and update faster.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Language Support[/h2][p]HVOR is now available in multiple languages:[/p][list][*][p]Deutsch (German)[/p][/*][*][p]Italiano (Italian)[/p][/*][*][p]Türkçe (Turkish)[/p][/*][*][p]中文 (Chinese)[/p][/*][*][p]日本語 (Japanese)[/p][/*][*][p]한국어 (Korean)[/p][/*][*][p]Español (Spanish)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]What This Means[/h2][p]Now that the game is fully running on a new architecture, we can release updates more frequently, add new modes and maps, and deliver improvements based on your feedback.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]One More Thing[/h2][p]HVOR remains a [b]free[/b] game, supported with enthusiasm and in the developers’ spare time.
Thank you for staying with us — the best is yet to come![/p]

notes.title: 2 new maps and 2 new game modes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi, we want to present a big update that we have been working on for the last 4 months.[/h1]

[h2]New maps[/h2]

[h3]Metro[/h3]
Metro, there are rumors that the disease was brought by a rat biting a passenger in the subway. The ghouls that are here are especially evil.

[h3]Shelter[/h3]
Shelter, many took shelter here when the street became dangerous. But the disease has also penetrated here, engulfing those who have taken refuge in it. They say there are a lot of weapons left in the bunker. But who will go to meet death ?

[h2]New game modes[/h2]

[h3]Rat[/h3]
Rats are able to adapt to any conditions, to any environment. But HVOR decided to adapt them by herself, making from these creatures creepy little zombies. The new role of rats in the food chain has not changed so much, but now we need to clearly understand what threat the new form of these rodents. In the rat mode, you have to collect a certain amount of biomaterial for research - dead rats. A flashlight will help to navigate in the dark.

[h3]Generator[/h3]
"The world has changed, but the infrastructure continues to work for unknown reasons.
Electricity is supplied, but sometimes there are failures. In the generator mode, you have to replenish the fuel supply in the generator. 
Look for cans, and take them to the generator. Darkness comes .."

notes.title: We are still alive....
Hi all! Hvor is already sixth day in early access.
notes.notes:
During this time, we found many technical and visual errors, some of which have already been fixed.
We have discovered many technical and visual errors.

What we did in the latest updates:
-Added support for English,
-Fixed visual errors at the hospital level,
-Added a tutorial section in the menu,
-Fixed several errors due to which the game crashed.

We are also aware of problems with game control, for many players its inconvenient. We are trying to solve this problem in the near future.
